description: Request an immediate docket refresh from court sources for one case (slower; use when you need the latest filings now). Pass simple_name or case_number. Single Case plan: monitored cases only. Full Access: any case. Subscribers only.

court.description: Court name as returned in the court field, for example "Delaware" or "Texas Southern".

court_state.description: 2-letter state. Matches every district in that state.
